name: Banksy
role: Anonymous English street artist (active since c. 2000)
summary: Banksy is an anonymous English street artist whose work, in its public descriptions, often uses satire of war, consumerism, authority and the art market. He has made few public statements in his own words on political questions that the test covers. The statements found concern the conditions in Gaza (2015) and a 2017 hotel in Bethlehem framed as a reflection on British policy in Palestine, and these do not match a specific statement in the test.
